title: HarnessQualityManifest
description: Cross-phase quality handoff contract. Generated at P2 exit, updated at each Gate.

fr_ids.description: All functional requirement IDs in scope

nfr_dimension_mapping.description: NFR-ID -> harness dimension name (e.g. NFR-01 -> security)

nfr_fr_mapping.description: Reverse mapping: NFR-ID -> list of FR IDs that implement it (e.g. NFR-02 -> [FR-04, FR-05])

nfr_traceability.description: NFR-ID -> {type, target, module} from SAD.md nfr_traceability block.

quality_targets.description: SAB quality targets (min_coverage, max_complexity, p95_latency_ms, etc.) for context in gate prompts.

fr_module_traceability.description: FR-ID -> responsible module path from SAD.md fr_module_traceability block.

architecture_constraints.description: Constraints from SAD.md (e.g. No synchronous I/O in main thread)

high_risk_modules.description: File paths flagged as high-risk in SAD.md

gate_score_overrides.description: Dimension-level threshold overrides auto-derived from quality_targets. Currently mapped: min_coverage → test_coverage (e.g. {test_coverage: 80}). Applied as a floor in finalize_gate().
